【原视频简介】
Are you curious about growing potatoes in containers but unsure which size works best? In this grow bag experiment, we’re finally performing our Kennebec potato harvest to see if the container size really makes a difference! We are comparing a 10 gallon vs 15 gallon grow bag to find out which one produces the best homegrown potatoes.

Whether you are looking for vegetable gardening for beginners or advanced container gardening tips, this potato harvest 2026 has some surprising results. We kept everything consistent—the same variety, organic soil, and fertilizer—to ensure these are the best grow bags for potatoes for your garden. Stick around for the final weight comparison and a special message of hope from Mountains in Heaven.

My best growing potato video link here: https://youtu.be/xfRyFNpFXSc

Organic potato growing results
Step-by-step potatoes in grow bags sifting
Final yield comparison: 10 vs 15 gallon
